name: CHIP TRACKER
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless 8-bit game music, written live in a tracker. Two pulses, triangle, noise.
description: CHIP TRACKER turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless 8-bit console soundtrack. Each song is written as real tracker patterns: a hummable lead on a pulse wave, a second pulse echoing, arpeggiating or harmonising, a driving triangle bass and noise drums, through intro, verse, chorus and bridge. After a few loops it ends on a jingle and a new song with a new title starts. The screen is the tracker: four scrolling pattern columns under a cursor bar and four live oscilloscopes. Thirteen styles, from Extra Life to Propeller Keep; knobs for tempo, energy, echo and mood.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
